desc:
Build an army and take on the world!

✨ April 3: added 2 new troops with healing powers! Full details on the event page or changelog.

📜 Full changelog at devforum.roblox.com/t/4323468

🔨 Build your army from a range of units: from infantrymen, to tanks, to attack helicopters.
🧠 Arrange your army's formation to maximize their combat power.
💥 Invade countries across the globe and plunder their loot to strengthen your army.
⏰ Your army invades and loots while you're offline.

Credit to @JohnDrinkin and @WhoToTrus for character assets.
